title: Rebuild the stock front brake master cylinder
completeness: Complete stock front-master cylinder kit replacement with lever, holder and hose refit, fluid replacement, bleeding and brake checks. Caliper remains installed and serviceable.
entry_state: Assembled exact US2025 stock YZ450F with serviceable front caliper, hose and disc.
Exact front master-cylinder replacement kit and union washers available.
exit_state: Master cylinder rebuilt, mounted and connected; lever and hose routing restored.
Front circuit bled and reservoir closed; brake function checked.

source.review_note: Independent review by year_groups_research: exact2025 text106–109/136–157/163–164 and visual7/107/108/137/138/145/147/148/150/156/157/164 support seals, lubrication, cup orientation, hardware, reservoir and bleed closure. Corrected stale inline2026 diagram references, numeric targetyear and encoding before freeze. No neighboring-year specification inheritance.

applicability.included: Stock front master cylinder on exact US2025 YZ450F
excluded: Damaged master-cylinder body or other brake components requiring replacement

required_tools.name: Stable support, suitable hand tools and precision torque tools
Retaining-ring tools and clean parts tray

required_parts.name: Exact new front master-cylinder kit
required_parts.purpose: Renew diagram139 kit; piston assembly and circlip explicitly NEW on145

required_parts.name: Silicone grease
required_parts.purpose: Pushrod end and lever locations marked on138/145

preflight: Use cup and retention diagrams142/148 throughout; all hydraulic parts must be clean.
Protect eyes and painted/plastic surfaces from fluid.
critical_stop_conditions: Damaged bore/body, incorrect kit or unseated retaining ring.
Fluid leakage, persistent air, spongy lever or improper braking.

steps.title: Prepare and drain
steps.instruction: Secure bike upright with reservoir horizontal; protect paint/plastics. Remove cap, diaphragm and float. Connect bleeder hose to catch container and drain front fluid using the lever/bleeder cycle; discard fluid.
steps.verification: Front circuit drained before master removal.
steps.origin: Yamaha OEM service manual; original factual companion

steps.title: Remove master cylinder
steps.instruction: Remove lever pivot nut/bolt and lever. Remove hose union and both washers, catching residual fluid under hose and master. Remove holder and master while retaining original location and starter-lead routing.
steps.verification: Hose protected; controls and lead not strained.
steps.origin: Yamaha OEM service manual; original factual companion

steps.title: Remove old cylinder kit
steps.instruction: Remove pushrod and boot; remove circlip and washer while controlling the spring-loaded piston. Withdraw piston/spring and old cups in diagram139/145 order. Keep the body bore undamaged.
steps.verification: Old kit removed; all positions identified from exploded view.
steps.origin: Yamaha OEM service manual; original factual companion

steps.title: Inspect and clean
steps.instruction: Replace damaged, scratched or worn master body and damaged reservoir cap. Inspect hose for cracks/damage/wear. Clear blocked body passages with compressed air. Wash body/internal parts with fresh DOT4; never solvent.
steps.verification: Record inspection; damaged body or hose requires replacement before proceeding.
steps.origin: Yamaha OEM service manual; original factual companion

steps.title: Build replacement piston
steps.instruction: Wet the new primary and secondary cups with DOT4 and install in the distinct positions and orientations shown on145. Fit spring with its smaller inside diameter toward piston.
steps.verification: Record both cup orientations against148; no reversal or torn lips.
steps.origin: Yamaha OEM service manual; original factual companion

steps.title: Install and retain piston
steps.instruction: Lubricate piston assembly and bore with DOT4. Insert new piston assembly, washer and new circlip, then boot and pushrod in diagram145 order. Apply silicone grease to pushrod end; verify circlip is seated.
steps.verification: Piston retained; boot seated and pushrod located correctly.
steps.origin: Yamaha OEM service manual; original factual companion

steps.title: Mount master and lever
steps.instruction: Refit holder with UP upward and reservoir level; preserve starter-lead route through holder. Tighten upper holder bolt first, then lower, both9 Nm. Apply silicone grease at diagram138 lever points; refit lever pivot bolt6 Nm and nut6 Nm.
steps.verification: Record holder sequence/torques and lever hardware; lever moves freely.
steps.origin: Yamaha OEM service manual; original factual companion

steps.title: Reconnect hose
steps.instruction: Use two new copper washers and tighten union30 Nm. Seat hose against master projection with bent portion downward as148/149. Turn bars both ways; hose must not contact wiring, cables or other parts.
steps.verification: Record washers,30 Nm and full-steering routing check.
steps.origin: Yamaha OEM service manual; original factual companion

steps.title: Fill for bleeding
steps.instruction: Fill reservoir above the minimum mark shown on PDF107 with fresh DOT4 and fit diaphragm. Attach a secure clear hose to bleeder, with its free end in a catch container. Keep reservoir supplied throughout; prevent water entry and overflow.
steps.verification: Reservoir horizontal; correct fluid and sufficient supply.
steps.origin: Yamaha OEM service manual; original factual companion

steps.title: Remove trapped air
steps.instruction: Slowly pump lever several times, then pull fully and hold. Open bleeder; close it before releasing lever. Repeat until hose fluid contains no bubbles, replenishing reservoir. If stubborn tiny bubbles persist, let fluid settle a few hours and repeat.
steps.verification: Record bubble-free result; never allow reservoir to empty.
steps.origin: Yamaha OEM service manual; original factual companion

steps.title: Close the circuit
steps.instruction: Tighten bleeder5 Nm and refit its cap. Restore fluid above the minimum mark shown on PDF107 with bike upright and reservoir horizontal. Refit float, diaphragm and cap in diagram138 order; cap screws1.5 Nm. Clean spills immediately.
steps.verification: Record final level, bleeder and cap torque; all openings closed.
steps.origin: Yamaha OEM service manual; original factual companion

steps.title: Verify brake function
steps.instruction: Apply front brake repeatedly and inspect hose/connections for leaks. Lever must not feel soft or spongy; bleed again if it does. After stationary checks pass, check brake effect on a dry test surface before normal riding. Confirm no lever-end free play and no brake drag.
steps.verification: Record no leaks, firm lever and proper braking; unresolved faults prevent completion.
steps.origin: Yamaha OEM service manual; original factual companion
